annotations.title: Which plan keeps the most at my volume

description: Compares selling plans at your price and monthly sales: Payhip Free, Plus and Pro, Gumroad direct and Discover, Ko-fi Shop and Ko-fi Gold, and Shopify Basic billed monthly or yearly. For each plan: fees per sale, monthly plan cost and what you keep a month after both. Returns the cheapest plan at your volume, the break-even sales a month between tiers (such as Payhip Plus vs Free), and which plan keeps the most at each volume. Every number comes from dated, sourced fee rows; a plan without sourced numbers is left out and named. US sellers, domestic cards. Read-only; sells nothing.

cost.description: Optional cost per item sold in USD, so the answer adds profit_per_month_usd and counts it in sales_to_cover_plan_cost. Default 0.

platforms.description: Optional filter: families (payhip, gumroad, ko-fi, shopify) and/or plan ids (payhip-free, payhip-plus, payhip-pro, gumroad-direct, gumroad-discover, ko-fi-shop, ko-fi-gold, shopify-basic-monthly, shopify-basic-yearly). Leave it out to compare every plan.

price.description: Your sale price per item in USD before buyer sales tax, in whole cents, e.g. 17.

processor.description: Card processor for the plans where you add your own (Payhip plans, Ko-fi Shop and Ko-fi Gold). "stripe" = 2.9% + $0.30 (default). "paypal" = PayPal Checkout or Guest Checkout, 3.49% + $0.49. Domestic cards only. Gumroad and Shopify charge their own processing.

sales_per_month.description: How many sales you make (or expect) in a month, a whole number, e.g. 50.
